qualifier: red cell gas exchange and Rh ammonium transport
name: Erythroid heme synthesis, gas exchange and Rh ammonium transport
rationale: Members cover heme/porphyrin biosynthesis, iron import and homeostasis, erythrocyte differentiation and red cell O2/CO2/NO transport; the red cell gas exchange and Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport members are what the heme-scavenging, iron-sulfur and transferrin confusables lack.

qualifier: CNS oligodendrocyte
name: CNS oligodendrocyte development, myelination and glial proliferation
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, CNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial proliferation/migration and reactive gliosis, distinguishing it from confusables centred on Schwann cell/PNS myelination, nodal assembly and axon regeneration.

qualifier: coronavirus targeting of host signalling and junction PDZ proteins
name: Viral protein maturation and coronavirus host-protein targeting
rationale: Members are maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion component assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host signalling and PDZ junction proteins, whereas confusables centre on viral attachment, entry and fusion.

core: Hematopoietic receptor tyrosine kinase and cytokine signalling
qualifier: FLT3 drug-resistant mutants with erythropoietin/thrombopoietin STAT5 signalling
name: FLT3 mutants and hematopoietic cytokine receptor signalling
rationale: Members are TKI-resistant and fusion FLT3 mutants plus erythropoietin, thrombopoietin and G-CSF receptor signalling via STAT5, PI3K and CBL, which separates it from confusables built on KIT, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR and ERBB2 mutants.

qualifier: triglyceride-rich particle assembly and dietary lipid digestion
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and dietary lipid digestion
rationale: Members cover chylomicron and VLDL assembly, dietary lipid digestion, acylglycerol transport and lipase/phospholipid catabolism, whereas confusables emphasise lipoprotein clearance, remodeling, HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: with restraint of ruffling, spreading and epithelial migration
name: Leading-edge actin protrusion with inhibited ruffling and spreading
rationale: Members promote actin polymerization, lamellipodia, pseudopodia and leading-edge localization while negatively regulating ruffles, cell spreading and epithelial migration; confusables instead involve actin severing, contraction and Arp2/3 nucleation.

qualifier: epithelial lineages, alveologenesis and lactation
name: Mammary epithelial lineage differentiation, alveologenesis and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar lineages, alveolus development and lactation, as opposed to confusables on ductal branching, involution or prostate/genital glands.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor ligand binding and neutrophil responses plus positive regulation of granulocyte/neutrophil chemotaxis, while confusables cover degranulation, extravasation and generic myeloid activation.

qualifier: placode-derived hair, tooth and gland plus melanocytes
name: Ectodermal placode, hair follicle, tooth and melanocyte development
rationale: Members span ectodermal placode and appendage formation (hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland, taste papilla, inner ear, cranial ganglion), melanocyte development and EDA-family TNF signalling, unlike confusables focused on keratinocyte cornification and skin barrier.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and integration
name: HIV early replication: entry, reverse transcription, integration
rationale: Members trace HIV binding, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis, PIC nuclear import, integration and circle formation, which confusables on influenza RNA synthesis, HCMV latency and APOBEC editing lack.

qualifier: activity-dependent growth and atrophy
name: Activity-dependent skeletal muscle adaptation and atrophy
rationale: Members concern muscle responses to activity and inactivity, atrophy, tissue growth and ubiquitin-mediated catabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on myogenesis, regeneration and cardiac muscle adaptation.

qualifier: NF-kB-driven, dendritic cell, TNF/IL-23 output
name: NF-kB-driven proinflammatory myeloid and dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members are myeloid and dendritic cell NF-kB activation modules, TNF/IL-23 inflammatory cytokine output and chronic inflammation regulation, while confusables concern T cell regulation, NK/IL-15 signalling or negative inflammatory control.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-20 and IL-12 families
name: IL-10, IL-20 and IL-12-family interleukin signalling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20-family, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signalling with IL-10 production regulation, distinguishing them from confusables on IL-17/IL-33/IL-36, IL-15/IL-21, type 2 cytokines and interferons.

qualifier: repair DNA synthesis via SDSA and break-induced replication
name: Synthesis-dependent double-strand break repair and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern repair DNA synthesis, unwinding and polymerase activation in SDSA, break-induced replication and sister chromatid exchange, whereas confusables cover NHEJ, break sensing, strand invasion and checkpoints.

qualifier: snoRNP/scaRNA and Cajal body telomerase assembly
name: RNA modification, snoRNP biogenesis and Cajal body telomerase assembly
rationale: Members cover rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation, box C/D snoRNP and scaRNA localization to Cajal bodies and telomerase holoenzyme assembly, unlike confusables on RNA transcription, processing, decay or mitochondrial RNA.

qualifier: deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain linkage, deubiquitination, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members span linkage-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/deneddylation, COP9 signalosome and proteasome assembly, whereas confusables emphasise protein quality control, aggrephagy, ERAD and degron pathways.

core: Receptor signalling to PI3K-AKT and RAS
qualifier: hematopoietic cytokine and LTK/ALK receptors
name: Hematopoietic cytokine and LTK/ALK receptor signalling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, CSF1, interleukin SHC and LTK/ALK signalling feeding PI3K-AKT, ERK and STAT5, distinguishing them from confusables on oncogenic RTK mutants, IGF1R/IRS and MET.

qualifier: TLR2/3/4 MyD88/TRIF with proinflammatory cytokine induction
name: Bidirectional TLR regulation and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signalling and promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, whereas confusables cover TAK1/IKK mechanics, inflammasomes or negative cytokine regulation.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply, sialylation and fucosylation
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and N-, O- and glycolipid glycosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialylation, fucosylation, glycosphingolipid and blood group antigen synthesis and their CDG defects, whereas confusables are GPI anchoring or lysosomal glycan catabolism.

qualifier: ischemic and hypoxic stress
name: ATP-sensitive potassium channels in ischemic and metabolic stress
rationale: Members are KATP channels and their ABCC8/ABCC9 disorders plus responses to ischemia, hydrogen sulfide and oxygen metabolism, unlike confusables on two-pore K+ channels, purinergic signalling or nitrosative stress.

qualifier: glyceride and lysophospholipid hydrolysis with retrograde signalling
name: Endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis and retrograde synaptic signalling
rationale: Members cover MAG/DAG and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, NAPE/NAE metabolism, arachidonate release and endocannabinoid retrograde signalling, whereas confusables concern glyceride synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and lipid transfer.

qualifier: SGLT/GLUT intestinal and renal glucose uptake
name: SGLT/GLUT-mediated intestinal and renal glucose transport
rationale: Members are cellular and intestinal hexose transport and SLC5A1/SLC5A2/SLC2A2 defects, distinguishing them from confusables on fructose/urate transport, galactose metabolism and anion exchangers.

qualifier: TRAIL death receptor signalling with TNF and necroptosis restraint
name: TRAIL and death receptor extrinsic apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate death-receptor extrinsic apoptosis, TRAIL signalling, execution-phase apoptosis and suppress TNF signalling, necrosis and hepatocyte apoptosis, unlike confusables on TNFR1-NF-kB, Fas/BID or caspase-8/necroptosis machinery.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in lung, mammary, prostate and exocrine glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching development of lung, mammary, prostate and glands
rationale: Members cover epithelial-mesenchymal (FGFR2b) signalling and branching in lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands plus related bud-derived structures, whereas confusables concern kidney, pancreas or female reproductive tract.

qualifier: primitive and definitive, through terminal enucleation
name: Primitive and definitive erythropoiesis through terminal enucleation
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, terminal maturation, membrane skeleton assembly and enucleation with hemopoietic transcriptional control, distinguishing them from confusables on HSC/myeloid progenitors and heme synthesis.
